segments.comment: topten.c topten() copynchars(t0->name, plname, NAMSZ) keeps 10 of the name's 15 bytes: "Rua", one four-byte character and three bytes of the next. The score list is raw output (patch 006 nomux_raw_putch()), which the recorder decodes as UTF-8, so the cut character reads as U+FFFD and the rest of the line shifts left by the bytes the decoded characters merge.
